name: GMO internet group, Inc.
summary: GMO internet group, Inc. provides various internet services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Internet Infrastructure Business, Internet Security Business, Internet Advertising and Media Business, Internet Financial Business, Crypto Asset Business, and Others Segments. The company offers domain, hosting, cloud, payment processing, e-commerce support, EC platform, customer attraction support, provider, free WiFi, web development support, electronic contracts, financial services, AI, and robotics services; and SSL and encryption, brand security, and cybersecurity.
